reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East

title.narrative: 2025 oPt Emergency Appeal - Gaza - Logistical Support to Common Services

description.narrative: UNRWA is the backbone of the overall emergency response in Gaza, with the entire humanitarian community relying on the Agency’s infrastructure, logistics and personnel to deliver common services and last-mile support. This includes the receipt, storage and onward distribution of assistance across Gaza, along with tracking and reporting on aid delivered. The Agency will use its trucks to transport assistance throughout the Strip and deploy personnel and pumps to coordinate fuel dispatches to hospitals, water desalination plants, sewage facilities, humanitarian actors and other critical service providers. UNRWA will also continue hosting humanitarian organizations and the inter-agency coordination mechanism at its Joint Humanitarian Operations Centre at the Agency’s Japanese Health Centre in Khan Younis, which currently accommodates around 40 agencies, including UN organizations, with more than 200 personnel, and international and national NGOs.
